name: state_machine_ux

Trace every View and UiAction entry/exit, stale action behavior, back/home semantics, destructive-action safety, and relevant tests. Report evidence-backed defects and smallest fixes.

Compare exact-board vendored examples only where needed. Report correctness failures, underrun risks, and smallest fixes.
